Package aor.proj3t.service

Class ServiceFactory

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.service.ServiceFactory
@ApplicationScoped public class ServiceFactory extends Object
Factory class to access all service implementations. This class provides a centralized access point for all the services in the application. It follows the Factory design pattern to encapsulate the instantiation logic of services and provides a clean, consistent API for accessing them. The factory is injected with all available services and offers type-safe methods to retrieve them.

Example usage: 

 User user = serviceFactory.forUser().findById(userId);
 List trainings = serviceFactory.forTraining().getAllTrainings();
